faq.title: The questions worth asking before, not after.
faq.lede: Anything missing here? Ask us directly.

items.q: Will my email break if I connect my own domain?
items.a: Not if it's done right. Connecting a site only changes the A and CNAME records. **The MX records, the ones that run your email, are never touched.** If you have email on the same domain, tell us before connecting and we'll double-check.

Your site ships with clean heading structure, tidy URLs, page descriptions and fast loading. That's the foundation Google needs. **We do not promise a position.** Anyone promising you first place is selling you something else.

items.q: Do I own the content and photos?
items.a: Yes. The content you upload stays yours, and so does the finished site. **In return, you confirm the photos and text are yours or that you have permission to use them.** That clause protects both of us.
Yes, at any point, in line with Israel's Consumer Protection Law. The full terms are in the Terms of Use. **Your content stays yours even after you cancel.**

The system produces a site with a sound technical baseline: semantic structure, keyboard navigation, form labels and measured contrast. **After publishing, though, the site is in your hands:** any content, image or change you add affects the result. **That's why we make no commitment about the accessibility of the site you publish; responsibility for it is yours.** We recommend consulting an accessibility professional before going live.
